The 5G network at Europe’s Spaceport topic is part of a major theme “1 - Infrastructure & Hardware” that CNES plans to develop, set up and qualify. Two publications are linked with this theme.
First one, the purpose of this publication is to emphasize on the industrial phase of the network infrastructure design and deployment which will be necessary to set up the private 5G network at the CSG space center. This 5G infrastructure will have to cover a 700 km2 area to deliver network associated services.
Then, this publication follows the 23.CSGT.009 one relevant to the technical support to CNES teams for their 5G related activities.
